messages:
olivia: Quick question about carryover & holiday swaps. I'm joining in June 2026 from the EU office and have 6 unused local public holidays. Company policy says local statutory holidays apply by location. Can I swap some of those into US floating days before my transfer?
sarah-peopleops: Welcome Olivia! We have a one-time swap option for cross-region moves but rules differ by region. For EU->US swap: up to 4 local public holidays can be converted to 2 US floaters (manager + HR approval). Please submit transfer notice with a list of days you want swapped.
dom-manager: Manager note: operationally we prefer swaps finalized at least 2 pay cycles before transfer to avoid manual payroll edits. Olivia, what's your official start in the US?
olivia: Target US start = 2026-06-30 (will be on EU payroll through 6/29). I can pick which 4 days to convert. Is there any tax consequence?
kevin-payroll: Tax note: converting days to paid floaters is treated as non-cash benefit (no additional taxable payout) if processed as an HR-accrual conversion. If we instead payout days, it will be taxable income in the payroll run that executes it. Also need employee ID on the form.
sarah-peopleops: Action items: 1) Olivia submit relocation & swap form: https://hr.redwood/transfer-swap 2) Dom approve manager checkbox 3) HR approves conversion 4) Payroll processes conversion on effective date. Please include employee ID and preferred swap mapping (which specific local dates to map).
hr-bot: Reminder: transfer-swap form must be submitted by 2026-06-10 to avoid manual payroll adjustments.
olivia: Submitted the form and attached the list of 6 dates, requested to convert 4 (2026-03-17, 2026-04-12, 2026-05-01, 2026-05-08) -> 2 US floaters. Form includes emp ID EOL456.
dom-manager: Approved. Noted for coverage during June ramp. Olivia, please add a brief handover doc in the onboarding folder.
kevin-payroll: Received the HR-approved conversion notice. We'll schedule conversion for 2026-06-30 payroll. If anything changes after the payroll cutoff (2026-06-15), we'll run a manual adjustment: payroll_tool --retro --emp EOL456 --swap 4->2 --effective 2026-06-30.
sarah-peopleops: Policy excerpt for clarity:
"Cross-region holiday conversion (snippet):
- One-time conversion allowed when transferring work location across countries
- Max conversion caps differ by source region; EU->US cap: 4 local -> 2 US floaters
- Conversions require manager + People Ops approval and must be filed before payroll cutoff to avoid manual adjustments
"
olivia: Thanks team, really appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll upload the handover and confirm final travel dates.
